# FLX-3702: the held-out profile is not apart from the calibration queries

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The profile given to --held-out answers the held-out queries only. A profile that names a calibration query is refused, so that the two sets of targets stay apart. A bundle that declares no held-out query has nothing to read the file for, and is refused too. The message names the query, or the missing declaration. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3702
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
